releases.name: v0.2.0 — Antigravity CLI support
releases.body:
Antigravity CLI (`agy`) can now show the active conversation title on its herdr tab. The hook runs on session start, before a prompt, and at the end of a turn. If the tab has more than one pane, it leaves the label alone, so an agy worker in a split pane won’t rename your workspace. The existing OpenCode label and manual-name rules are unchanged.

**Install for agy** (tested with agy 1.5.16 and herdr 0.9.5; Node.js 24.4+ must be on `PATH`):

```sh
git clone --branch v0.2.0 --depth 1 https://github.com/nxxxsooo/opencode-herdr-tab-title.git
agy plugin install ./opencode-herdr-tab-title
```

For an existing agy install, install again from the updated checkout. For OpenCode, run `opencode plugin add @nxxxsooo/opencode-herdr-tab-title@latest` to install or `opencode plugin update @nxxxsooo/opencode-herdr-tab-title@latest` to update.

[Release checks](https://github.com/nxxxsooo/opencode-herdr-tab-title/actions/runs/45400857344) passed and verified the published npm files against this tag. [Full changes since v0.1.0](https://github.com/nxxxsooo/opencode-herdr-tab-title/compare/v0.1.0...v0.2.0).
